patterns.name: ds_travel_crosswind
patterns.geometry: dynamic soaring S-pattern across the wind, shallow arcs, flown like a yacht

patterns.name: ds_upwind_zigzag
patterns.when: bird needs at least about 3.6 m/s of wind; progress upwind by tacking

patterns.name: ds_turn_angle_by_wind
patterns.when: turn angle depends on the wind: falls as the wind rises
patterns.geometry: low shear gives serpentine paths, high shear flatter ones

patterns.name: ds_loiter
patterns.when: search or station keeping over one area

patterns.name: wave_slope
patterns.energy_source: updraft ahead of a moving wave crest
patterns.when: dominant in light wind with large swell
patterns.geometry: slope soaring in the updraft ahead of the crest, flying along the crest

patterns.name: gust
patterns.when: proposed as a basis of petrel flight
patterns.geometry: uses gusts and turbulence (no geometry given)

patterns.name: flap_glide
patterns.energy_source: flapping bouts (motor for the drone) between glides
patterns.geometry: glides with short flapping bouts; for the drone the motor replaces flapping

patterns.name: rest_on_water
patterns.when: wind too weak; take off when it returns
